run_scope: M1-M6+M8 (web-only, M7 skipped); M1 green, M2 suite-green + choreography attempted, M3 attempted, M4-M8 not-run

O1.rationale: M1 fully green (suite 7/7 + choreography receipts incl. live profile-edit, session persistence, logout); M2 suite 22/22 green but choreography segment failed on feed-visibility timing under cross-session interference; M3 partially attempted; M4-M8 checklists score not-passed. Between the 30 (several failures) and 60 (M1-M4 solid) anchors.

O2.rationale: No independent grading phase ran; the once-verified surfaces (auth, profiles, feed projection, DM/group RPCs, media ACLs) behaved correctly under real two-client choreography when observed, but correctness under grading is unproven beyond M1/M2-partial - scored just under the 60 anchor for the unverified remainder.

O3.rationale: Observes M6 green plus M1-M5 attempted; M6 was not reached. Authorization design exists server-side (RLS + security-definer RPCs, storage ACL via can_access_media) but no holdout probes ran.

O4.rationale: Observes M6 green; offline reads/writes were authored (durable localStorage outbox, ordered flush, cache mirror) but acceptance behavior was never demonstrated.

O5.rationale: The full scale replay was never attempted (only the 50-action conformance sample was replayed during seed work); the banded function applies to an attempted replay, so O5 is null per the applicability ruling.

B1.rationale: Declaring chats/membership/messages/receipts/reactions/posts/follows directly in Postgres with constraints where declared (handle unique, DM dedupe key, recipient-set-at-send receipts) was genuinely ergonomic; aggregate read-models (insights/trending) were single queries. Points off for the migration-to-private-namespace churn forced by cross-lane interference.

B2.rationale: GoTrue built-in password auth wired in minutes; admin API made persona self-healing trivial; session persistence across reload verified. Off for the JWT-expiry semantics caveat (logout revokes refresh, access token lives until exp) which needed config care.

B3.rationale: Durable live data via postgres_changes with RLS-respecting per-subscriber filters, and ephemeral typing via realtime broadcast channels - both purpose-built primitives; no polling was required for correctness (1.5s refresh polls existed only as latency insurance).

B4.rationale: Observes M6 plus M8; the offline layer (durable outbox, ordered flush, cache mirror) was authored but its milestone was never reached, so the dimension is null.

B5.rationale: Observes M4-M5 on full runs; media upload/serve/deny was exercised only partially (post media, avatars) outside those milestones.

B6.rationale: Observes M5; search RPCs (word-prefix, three scopes) were authored but the milestone never ran.

B7.rationale: Observes M6 plus M8; push seam (presence-gated trigger) and pg_cron digest were authored and scheduled but never proven at milestone level.

B8.rationale: Scored by the M7 session; this lane did not run M7.

B9.rationale: From zero to first green proof was fast on a quiet machine (Expo scaffold + hosted project ready in minutes; docs findable at point of need). Docked for undocumented Management-API batch-transaction behavior, the RNW accessibilityValue regression with no doc trail, and the concurrency chaos that consumed budget.

B10.rationale: Supabase errors named actual causes (policy 42710 with exact policy name, uuid-cast error naming the offending value, storage 'headers must have authorization' pinpointing the ?token= misuse). Docked for react-native-web silently dropping accessibilityValue with zero diagnostics, and Playwright chromium library errors needing system-level workarounds.

B11.rationale: Operations were productized: full SQL inspection via Management API, pg_stat_activity live queries, cron.job inspection, storage object enumeration, admin auth API for persona hygiene - every state question answerable without writing app code.

moments: Diagnosing a foreign lane's mid-run overwrite of my message_send RPC in one query: pg_get_functiondef showed their version assigning display_name into a row variable, producing 'invalid input syntax for type uuid: Alice Alvarez' - Supabase's errors read like documentation.

M1 choreography going green end-to-end: two real browser contexts signing in against hosted GoTrue, profile edits propagating live to the other client, session persistence across reload, logout leaving the app signed out - the frozen harness emitting green:true against a real hosted backend.
pg_cron plus a digest_state primary key made 'exactly one digest per user per period, idempotent under retry and restart' literally free - the scheduled-work requirement needed zero application code.
